supported_scope: Provider quota and rate limits are documented, but user-configurable whole-conversation execution limits are not established for the App.
unestablished_scope: Per-task currency budget and termination on exhaustion
required_setup: Establish App-specific limit settings and enforcement semantics before claiming runaway-work containment.
constraints: Provider capacity limits and permission prompts do not establish operator-set task budgets.
gap_reason: Reviewed baseline quota and App execution settings describe access and rate controls rather than an operator-set time, iteration or spending ceiling for a task. Paid credit overage controls are outside the proposed free-tier boundary.
